panelTitle: Quantization Tradeoff Matrix · Measured tok/s per Quant
intro: One model family, every community-measured quantization side by side: FP16/FP8 down to GGUF Q4_K_M and below. Click any row to load that quant's best measured speeds into the simulator — the fastest way to answer "can I drop to Q4 and still hit my tok/s on this card?".
familyAria: Model family for the quantization matrix
loadTitle: Load quantization rows for this family
loadAria: Load quantization rows for this model family
loading: Querying measured quants for this family…
noRuns: No community-measured quantizations found for this family. Try a shorter family key (e.g. llama-3-1-8b) — repo/quant variants collapse into it.
banner: {family}: {rows} measured quant{rowsPlural} across {runs} single-stream runs. Rows ranked highest-fidelity first.
mixedEnginesTitle: This row mixes engine builds across rigs — treat the delta with caution
vramTitle: Estimated weights-only VRAM: parameter count × bits-per-weight ÷ 8. KV cache, activations and framework overhead are excluded.
qualityNoticeable: Noticeable quality loss — verify on your task
legend: Medians are outlier-resistant per hardware×quant cohort; rigs × runs shows sample size; * = mixed engine builds in the row.
appliedBanner: {quant} loaded into the simulator at its best measured prefill/decode speeds.
